extracted.name: Orzo and Rice
extracted.description: An orzo rice dish. Orzo pasta, toasted golden brown in butter, is cooked in bouillon with rice to make an easy and versatile side. Garnish with herbs.
instruction_lines: In a large heavy saucepan, melt butter over medium heat; add orzo and brown until golden.
Add rice, bouillon, and water; bring to a boil, cover and lower heat to medium-low.
Simmer for about 20 to 25 minutes or until all water is absorbed; serve.
